skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic concepts of social insurance fund management including financial management, audit, and inspection.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Financial Management of Social Insurance Funds
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply basic concepts of financial management of social insurance funds to analyze and monitor related processes.
Apply basic concepts of audit of social insurance to analyze and monitor related processes.
Apply basic concepts of inspection of social insurance activities to analyze and monitor related processes.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Policy and Strategy Development for Social Insurance Agencies
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply principles of social insurance management to develop policies and strategies for organizational development of social insurance agencies.
Develop research and independent work skills, with the ability to organize and manage resources for specialized professional management activities in social insurance.
Demonstrate self-reliance when working independently, show personal responsibility and inspire team members in assigned tasks and social activities.
